**What I verified in the pinned tree** (`6ea321f`):

- **P1 — the advisory target.** `Link::isAllowedUri()` (`src/Marks/Link.php:30-42`) has no type test; `renderHTML` feeds it the raw `href` (`:77`). An array `href` survives `preg_replace` (:36 accepts array subjects) and throws at `preg_match` (:41); an object throws at :36. No test in the repo exercises a non-string href.
- **P2 — the shared layer under the symptom.** `HTML::renderAttributes()` normalises only booleans (`src/Utils/HTML.php:48-58`) and then calls `htmlentities($value)` (`:64`). Every declared attribute of every extension flows there through `DOMSerializer::renderOpeningTag` (`src/Core/DOMSerializer.php:217-252`, call at `:277`), so `target`, `rel`, Image `src`, etc. are all unguarded.
- **P3/P4 — the text branches.** `htmlspecialchars($node->text)` at `src/Core/DOMSerializer.php:77` and a separate copy at `src/Core/TextSerializer.php:46`, the latter reachable only via `getText()`.
- **P5 — per-extension stringification.** `TableCell` `join(',', $attributes->colwidth)` (`src/Nodes/TableCell.php:57`), `CodeBlock` language concatenation (`src/Nodes/CodeBlock.php:59-61`), and the style interpolations in Color/TextAlign/FontFamily/Highlight.

**Stacking result:** 7 candidate traps, all with distinct fix sites (7 independent groups). The recommended 5-trap design is T1 (anchor) + T2 (shared attribute sink, deepseek-type) + T3 (coupled `colwidth`/int `colspan`, mimo-type) + T4 (text in DOMSerializer) + T5 (text in TextSerializer, M2). It carries two genuine interactions: a T2→T3 conflicting fix (a blanket `is_string` filter breaks the passing `TableTest` expectations `colspan="2"` / `data-colwidth="100,0"`) and T1→T2/T4 masking in a single document.
